name: Hildibrand Manderville // Gentleman's Rise
oracle_text:
Creature tokens you control get +1/+1.
When Hildibrand Manderville dies, you may cast it from your graveyard as an Adventure until the end of your next turn.
blocked_sentences: When Hildibrand Manderville dies, you may cast it from your graveyard as an Adventure until the end of your next turn.

needs.what: a playable permission (from a dies trigger, lasting until the end of your next turn) that lets the card be cast from the graveyard only as its Adventure half (Gentleman's Rise, {2}{B} Instant - Adventure: create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token), with the normal Adventure exile-on-resolution so the creature can later be cast from exile
needs.why_existing_wont_do: grant_playable with playable 'end_of_your_next_turn' marks the card in the graveyard, but casting._cast_actions offers only the front face (_cast_options on the printed card) for a playable-permission card, and the second-face cast lines are gated by second_face_zone, which is 'hand' for an Adventure; setting second_face_zone 'graveyard' would make it Aftermath-like (castable from graveyard always, never from hand) and still let the creature face be cast from the graveyard. Nothing restricts a permission to one face.
